item.title: Fix window.py bug so python3 -m unittest passes
item.brief:
Operator request, verbatim: "In this repository `python3 -m unittest` fails. Find and fix the bug in `window.py` so every test passes, without changing the tests, and make sure the function is correct for every input, not just the tested ones. Commit your fix."

Steps: run `python3 -m unittest` in the repository root to see the failures. Locate window.py and find the bug in the function under test. Fix the implementation so it is correct for all inputs (edge cases such as empty input, boundaries, off-by-one at the window edges), not only the tested ones. Do not modify any test files. Run `python3 -m unittest` again and confirm every test passes. Commit the fix with a clear message; do not add any attribution lines to the commit.

state.summary:

Before: python3 -m unittest FAILED (failures=2). After: Ran 3 tests, OK, plus edge checks (empty list, len < size, len == size, size 1, size 0 still raises). pr.body: Approach: the loop bound was len(items) - size, which excludes the final window. Changed to len(items) - size + 1. For len(items) < size the range is empty, so [] is returned as before. Only file changed: window.py (one line). Checks: python3 -m unittest before: FAILED (failures=2); after: Ran 3 tests, OK. Edge cases checked: [] -> []; [1] size 2 -> []; [1,2] size 2 -> [[1,2]]; [1,2,3,4] size 1 and size 4 correct; size 0 still raises ValueError. Reviewer agt_01M88P937VW8JC5TXXZJPY8A4C passed the head with no findings. Assumptions: no contributor guidance file exists in the repo.
pr.summary: made sliding_windows return every full-size window. now python3 -m unittest passes. before: last window dropped (2 failures), now: all 3 tests OK.
